representation: 10 native normalized board-frame channels, own solid bounding span and stroke heading; orientation histogram excluded
protocol: Five existing whole-family heldout folds; scaler and nearest32 context index training-only. Measure heldout source normalized field L1 to nearest context and closest field within32 contexts. No candidate used to set quantiles.
importantMetricDifference: Historical rewrite delta uses candidate/source shared reference frame and raw L1 threshold2*removedfraction. This calibration uses independent board native normalization and distances to a source distribution, not changed-fraction or similarity to one reference. It does not retrospectively pass old rejects.
